entities.summary: Vytautas Petrulis was a Lithuanian banker and politician. He was the minister of finance (1922–1925), prime minister (1925), and speaker of the Seimas (1925–1926). He is often nicknamed "the father of the litas" as it was during his term as minister of finance that the Lithuanian litas was introduced.
